summary: Implemented the Tabs feature without running any code or tests, as instructed. Changes: new src/textual/widgets/tabs.py (Tab, TabsRenderable, Tabs with keyboard handling, search, digit rules, click action range_clicked, and a watcher that animates bar_position); UnderlineBar gained clickable_ranges (before width) that attaches @click metadata per column span, with output unchanged when no ranges are given; Opacity now merges blended color into the existing style so metadata is preserved; docs/reference/tabs.md added; one new test added to tests/renderables/test_underline_bar.py. Layout resolver needed no change since its Edge already declares size, min_size, and fraction. Not done: sandbox demo (optional) and Tabs widget tests. Unverified: rich 11 Style.from_meta and Style addition preserving metadata, and all tests (not run). Known limitation: tab_padding=0 behaves as auto-fit due to the resolver's existing size-or-None handling. Nothing was committed.
